notes.title: 🧹 Devlog #3 - September
notes.content: [h1][b]🧹 Playtest Has Ended – Thank You![/b][/h1][p]Hello everyone![/p][p]The [b]Playtest of Cleaning Simulator[/b] has officially come to an end. We would like to sincerely thank all the players who tried the game, shared their feedback, and helped us improve. 🙏[/p][hr][/hr][h2]💬 Player Feedback[/h2][p]During the Playtest, you provided us with valuable insights about:[/p][list][*][p]Gameplay mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Camera and controls[/p][/*][*][p]The overall experience[/p][/*][/list][p]These contributions will play a major role in shaping the future of the game.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🚀 Next Step: Demo Version[/h2][p]While the Playtest has ended, we have exciting news:[/p][list][*][p][b]The demo version will be available very soon![/b][/p][/*][*][p]You’ll be able to experience the first levels in a more stable and optimized build.[/p][/*][*][p]Many of the improvements based on your feedback will be included in the demo.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🙌 Thank You[/h2][p]Your support and participation mean a lot to us. Together, we’re making Cleaning Simulator better.[/p][p]🧹 [b]See you in the demo![/b] ✨[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]— [i]The Cleaning Simulator Dev Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🧹 Devlog #2 - August
notes.content: [h2]🧹 Cleaning Simulator Playtest is Live![/h2][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! ✨[/p][p]A while ago, we announced our [b]partnership with RockGame[/b]. Now, we’re excited to share another big step in our journey: [b]the Playtest version of Cleaning Simulator is available now![/b] 🚀[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584891/b5f5230febde02225aaf56f136149e406a0f0cb9.png"][/img][/p][h2]🧽 What’s Included in This Version?[/h2][list][*][p]🏠 Play the first tasks and experience the cleaning mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 Test the controls and get a feel for the atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p]💬 Share your feedback and directly contribute to the development process.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]❓ Why a Playtest?[/h2][p]This Playtest allows us to share an early stage of the game with players and learn more about:[/p][list][*][p]🕹️ [b]How smooth the controls feel[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🔧 [b]How clear and functional the mechanics are[/b][/p][/*][*][p]🌍 [b]The overall gameplay experience[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🔑 How to Join[/h2][p]Joining the Playtest is easy:[/p][olist][*][p]Go to our Steam page 👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3537950/Cleaning_Simulator/"]Cleaning Simulator[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Click the [b]“Request Access”[/b] button.[/p][/*][*][p]Once access is granted, download the build and start playing![/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2]💡 What We Expect From You[/h2][list][*][p]🐞 Report any bugs or issues you encounter.[/p][/*][*][p]📝 Share your thoughts about the gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]🚀 Give us suggestions on how to improve the experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🙌 Thank You[/h2][p]Thank you in advance for joining this Playtest. Your feedback is valuable and will help shape the future of Cleaning Simulator.[/p][p][/p][p]🧹 [b]Let’s make the game shine together![/b] ✨[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]— [i]The Cleaning Simulator Dev Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🧹 Devlog #1 - July
notes.content:
[p][b]
Hello Cleaners![/b][/p][p]We’ve been keeping things tidy in the background for a while, but today we’re excited to spill the beans (and then clean them up right after): [/p][p][b]Cleaning Simulator has officially started a cooperation with RockGame![/b] 🎉[/p][p]This is a huge milestone for us and for all our hardworking cleaners out there. Together, we’re bringing new ideas, fresh content, and a polished experience to the game.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]🧼 What’s been happening lately?[/b][/p][p]Over the past few weeks, we’ve:[/p][list][*][p]Refined our cleaning mechanics for smoother interaction[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked parts of the UI for better immersion[/p][/*][*][p]Improved item physics and trash detection[/p][/*][*][p]Begun planning brand-new areas for you to clean — with a surprise or two 👀[/p][/*][/list][p]You might not see all of these yet, but trust us: they’re scrubbing away behind the scenes.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]✨ What’s next?[/b][/p][p]In the coming weeks, we’ll be focusing on:[/p][list][*][p]A new level we can’t wait to show you[/p][/*][*][p]Expanding customization options[/p][/*][*][p]Our first batch of community feedback implementation[/p][/*][/list][p]Expect the next devlog soon, where we’ll reveal more about the new location![/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45584891/d4f8eb4552581b6cc49e3a6cbae543829628926a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Don’t forget to [b]add Cleaning Simulator to your wishlist[/b] and [b]follow the game[/b] to stay up-to-date![/p][p]→ [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3537950/Cleaning_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][/p][p]See you in the next devlog![/p][p]🧽✨[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]— [i]The Cleaning Simulator Dev Team[/i][/p][p] [/p]
